videos.t: Filament Strength Testing: E3D spoolWorks Edge - How strong is it?
videos.desc:
This is the first video of a series in which I'm testing the static tensile strength of E3D spoolWorks Edge material.

http://e3d-online.com/SpoolWorks/Spoolworks-Oxford-Blue22-3D-Printer-Filament

Specimens were printed under the following conditions:
230°C hotend
80°C bed
100% infill
0.4mm nozzle
6 perimeters for the lying specimens
1 perimeter for the upright specimens
50mm/s

Measured properties:
Tensile strength lying: 50MPa (7.3ksi)
Tensile strength upright: 17MPa (2.4ksi)
Young's modulus: 1700MPa
Breaking strain: greater 100%

videos.t: Why a Filament Oiler ruins the Strength of your 3D Prints
videos.desc:
I test the effect of a filament oiler on PLA 3D prints. It doesn't only make a mess on the build platform, oiling the filament highly decreases the layer adhesion of your parts. My tests specimens broke at 60% less load when the filament ran through a filament oiler.

Watch Barnacules video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aFsgWr7gApM

####The results####
HORIZONTAL
Reference: 59.9 MPa
Oiled: 56.6 MPa
VERTICAL:
Reference: 40.3 MPa
Oiled: 15.9 MPa
